package database

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"

	_ "github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql"
	"github.com/maarifnu/dapodik_api/internal/config"
)

// New opens a MySQL connection using the separated config fields and verifies it with a ping.
func New(cfg config.Database) (*sql.DB, error) {
	dsn := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s@tcp(%s:%s)/%s?parseTime=true",
		cfg.Username,
		cfg.Password,
		cfg.Hostname,
		cfg.Port,
		cfg.Name,
	)

	db, err := sql.Open("mysql", dsn)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sql.Open: %w", err)
	}

	if err := db.Ping(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("db.Ping: %w", err)
	}

	return db, nil
}
